Simple and searched CASE; expression or statement

r := CASE v_grade
       WHEN 'A' THEN 'top'
       WHEN 'B' THEN 'good'
       ELSE 'other'
     END;

Callable from SQL when they have no side effects
Specification (public) and body (implementation); group related code, hold state
BEFORE/AFTER, row or statement level; :NEW and :OLD give row values
sides.code:
CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_audit
BEFORE UPDATE ON emp
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  :NEW.updated_at := SYSDATE;
END;
/

sides.text: Batch SQL calls to avoid row-by-row context switches between PL/SQL and SQL engines
Process large sets in chunks to bound memory
Use bind variables with USING to prevent SQL injection; DBMS_ASSERT for identifiers
sides.code:
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'UPDATE emp SET sal = sal + :1 WHERE id = :2'
  USING 100, 7;

sides.text: Independent commit, often used for logging
Stream rows to the caller as they are produced
Avoids the mutating-table error by sharing state across timing points
Use compound triggers, or move logic out of the row trigger
sides.code:
-- ORA-04091: table is mutating
-- A row trigger reads or changes its own table mid-statement

Definer rights (default) run with the owner's privileges; AUTHID CURRENT_USER uses the caller's
sides.code: CREATE PROCEDURE p AUTHID CURRENT_USER IS ...
